name: loop_view_axis
description: LP-4f1: a loop over the cube's faces, built on the Graph tab with Studio's controls only. The fixture carries the cube_capture feature, so the frame plan lists passes of the $capture/cube family with the face axis. Add loop puts a loop over a new, empty body in the root; its Loop fields' Over is set to View axis, and the family and the axis are chosen from what the frame plan lists ($capture/cube, face) -- nothing typed. Its count is the axis's length, read only (x6 (face)), and the zone's heading says so. The body is chosen from the branch table's list: the fixture's cube_face, a fullscreen pass of the $capture/cube family drawing into an image of the cube's size (Studio's Add fullscreen pass draws into a screen-sized image, and the engine stops a family that spans two raster extents). The pass's View field offers Each element (loop), which writes view_select face {$expr: element}. The engine expands the loop six times, one copy a face: the frame plan's copies run for faces 0 to 5, and the Frame Plan shows them as one group of six.
